messages:
tara (release-manager): @here final sanity check for the 11:00–12:00 change window. We go into freeze at 10:50. Quick checklist: canary plan, rollback playbook, version pins, and release notes posted. Reply with ✅ when you’ve validated your area.

sam (eng-releases): Canary config uploaded to the release bucket. Canary size = 5% traffic for 15m, thresholds: error>2% or latency p95 > 800ms -> halt.

mira (oncall): Oncall acked. I’ll monitor SLOs and error budget during canary. Pager escalation set to me + liam if >3% errors for 10m.

jonas (eng-runtime): Pinning runtime to v2.4.1 for this rollout — no hot kernels this window. Noted model runtime patch on staging, not in prod.

liam (sre): Observability checks green. Kibana dashboards: `release/canary/*` prewired. Alert rule IDs: `RBK-431`, `LAT-210`. I’ll keep a 5-min watch after canary start.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot started canary job 2105129999-CR. Canary instances: 3 -> 3. Streaming logs to /var/logs/releases/2105129999-canary.log

tara (release-manager): mira/liaM, quick confirm on rollback steps and who executes rollback. Also need confirmation release notes link posted to #release-notes.

mira (oncall): Rollback playbook is in the runbook: https://wiki.redwood/rollbacks/2105. Primary rollback is automated rollback job `rollback-job --tag v2.4.0` (ops trigger). If automated rollback fails, manual fallback: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/redwood-api --to-revision=123`. I’ll be ready to execute.

sam (eng-releases): Release notes posted here: https://docs.redwood/releases/2105-notes.md — includes changelog, migration notes, known issues. Added a highlighted note about embeddings quantization change.

liam (sre): Small nit: make sure dedicated customers are excluded from canary routing. Can we confirm routing policy?

jonas (eng-runtime): Confirmed — `route: tech_tier == standard && region == us-west-2` applied. Dedicated capacity pinned to v2.3.9 and excluded.

ops-bot: ops-bot recorded freeze window: start=2026-06-15T10:50:00Z end=2026-06-15T12:00:00Z. No schema migrations allowed during freeze.

tara (release-manager): Perfect. Final checklist: (1) Pins applied — jonas ✅ (2) Canary config — sam ✅ (3) Rollback playbook — mira ✅ (4) Release notes — sam ✅ (5) Observability & alerts — liam ✅. Plan to unmute metrics 5m before canary.

mira (oncall): Running final smoke at 10:40 now. Quick smoke output: `200 OK` for /health and /v1/generate baseline. No errors.

deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-06-15T10:55:00Z. 5% traffic routed. Monitoring hooks enabled.

liam (sre): Canary p95 latency steady at 420ms, error rate 0.9% after 4m. All good so far.

tara (release-manager): If anyone sees sustained degradation escalate to 🔴 and we run the rollback flow. Mira, you have authority to trigger auto-rollback if thresholds hit.

mira (oncall): On it. If I trigger rollback, I’ll post the command I ran and the reason.

sam (eng-releases): One more: add a tiny post-launch follow-up task to validate token-level billing for the new quantization option. I added it to the checklist in the notes.

tara (release-manager): Great. Locking freeze in 5. Good luck everyone — fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:

ops-bot: ops-bot: freeze locked by tara at 2026-06-15T10:45:00Z. Exceptions: none.

deploy-bot: Canary steady-state reached at 2026-06-15T11:10:00Z. Canary metrics: errors=0.7% p95=430ms. Proceeding with gradual ramp to 25% per release plan.

liam (sre): Ramp looks clean. Continuing watch.

tara (release-manager): If ramp completes without incidents we unfreeze at 12:00 and start full rollout. If any bork, we revert and keep freeze extended until RCA. Thanks all.

mira (oncall): Acknowledged.

jonas (eng-runtime): Noted. Leaving a snippet here for manual rollback steps if needed:

```
# manual rollback fallback
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/redwood-api --to-revision=123
# or run fallback job
./scripts/rollback-job --env prod --tag v2.4.0 --force
```

sam (eng-releases): Closing note: post-mortem template will be pre-populated if we hit rollback — ping me and I’ll create the doc.

tara (release-manager): Thread closed for pre-launch checks. I’ll re-open if anything pops. :white_check_mark:
